title: Time and Place Words in Retelling
goal: Review the time and place words that change when you retell, add the rest of the list and venir becoming ir, and learn when they stay.
grammar: Time and place words in reported speech

items: I can change time and place words when I retell what someone said (hoy becomes aquel día, aquí becomes allí).
I can change este to aquel and venir to ir, and keep the words when the time and place have not changed.
I can use the new words for the day before, here and there.
